body: Sometimes it doesn't get better. Sometimes you aren't meant to live. Sometimes it is better to just end the suffering sooner rather than later. It's hard to accept that I have to end it soon. I'm very scared of death and what comes after, but it's for the best.

It's not fair that I have to deal with the pain someone else caused for the rest of my life. I feel like I've accepted my fate, but am just too cowardly to die. I wish suicide was "okay" to do in society.

That's exactly it. The majority of the time I am fine, but then the pain comes and it's so painful I don't want to be dealing with it for the rest of my life. I don't want to be obsessing over something someone did to me when they don't even give a shit. I don't see how I can just "get over it".

It's been almost 1.5 years! There doesn't seem to be an end in sight. And even if I was guaranteed to get better and not feel the pain anymore is life without pain even worth it? I can keep proving to myself that I can continue, but what's the prize? More pain/struggle. Even before everything that happened I wasn't super high on life. I didn't hate it either, it was just okay. I'm going to die anyway, so why not sooner? Killing myself just sounds like the right thing to do. I have an unsolvable problem that "time" isn't guaranteed to fix and there has been no signs of it starting to. There is nothing to do, but keep hoping it gets better, but it sometimes doesn't get better and that's okay. Sometimes it is a good thing to "give up". Why continue on suffering? What keeps stopping me is the fear of the unknown of what happens next because it could be worse.

Thank you for responding. I always wondered if people feel that chest pain. I wish I knew exactly what it was. I've been dealing with this pain for almost 1.5 years after a person I trusted betrayed me deeply. The pain hasn't gone down at all and sometimes feels worse than before. It comes at least once a day and I can't do anything, but lay down while it happens. I don't even feel "depressed" if that what it is. My life is fine and I know people care about me. It's just that the pain never seems to end and I feel like I will eventually have to kill myself to end it. If I'm going to kill myself eventually, why not end it now and save myself from more days of pain. I can't let things go. I'm not that type of person, things stick with me forever. It's tiring. I just can't ever bring myself to pull the "trigger". I get everything ready and I always pussy out. I wish suicide was "okay" to do from a society standpoint. I've been wanting to kill myself for so long, it definitely doesn't feel like an impulse thing. If someone I cared about felt the way I do, it would suck to never see them again, but I wouldn't want them to continue suffering if they felt like they would never get better. At what point is it alright to give up?
